backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (Festival, Mantra, Aarti, CommunityPost, etc.) and state maps for a Hindu devotional app, with admin initialization, blob storage, authorization, and user approval mixins included.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades CommunityPost records on canister upgrade, converting the old two-variant status type to a three-variant one by mapping legacy rejected posts to pending.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (Internet Identity login, Vrat Katha visibility, community post visibility, PWA TTS) to their relevant frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted documentation file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file documenting the optional Google Gemini API key configuration, noting it is stored client-side in localStorage and never sent to the backend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS base styles defining OKLCH color system CSS variables for light and dark themes, storing only the L C H components without the oklch() wrapper for Tailwind compatibility.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes under an AppLayout shell, wrapped in QueryClientProvider, ThemeProvider (dark default), and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Presentational card component for an Aarti entry, displaying a flame icon, name, Hindi text preview, and optional deity tag, navigating to the aarti detail route on click.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main app layout component that renders the header with logo and login button, a notification banner, the routed page content via Outlet, bottom navigation, and a profile setup modal for authenticated users without a profile.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with nine nav items (Home, Panchang, Jap, Aarti, etc.) that highlights the active route using TanStack Router's state.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Renders a single chat message bubble for either the user or AI assistant, including text-to-speech play/pause/stop controls using the useSpeechNarration hook with Hindi language detection.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Displays an animated three-dot typing indicator with an AI guru avatar, shown while the AI is generating a response.
frontend/src/components/CommunityPostCar: Renders a community post card with author info, text content, lazy-loaded image/video/file attachments, a like button, and a deity tag badge.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Displays a styled daily dharma quote card with Hindi and English text fetched from the backend, falling back to a hardcoded Bhagavad Gita quote while loading.
frontend/src/components/EkadashiReminder: Shows a dismissible banner reminding users of an upcoming Ekadashi date (within 7 days) based on a hardcoded 2026 date list, with session-storage-based dismissal.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Displays a festival countdown card showing the festival name, description, days remaining, and a share button that uses the Web Share API or clipboard fallback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders six animated lotus petal images fixed to the background using CSS keyframe animation, floating and rotating at various positions and speeds.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: Wraps children in a sized container with a pulsing radial golden glow halo effect using CSS animation.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a Hindu katha story showing deity emoji, title, preview text, category badge, and navigates to the katha detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: Shows a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and optional text label as a loading indicator in three sizes.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication, showing loading, authenticated, and unauthenticated states with appropriate icons.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: Displays a full-screen animated overlay with a lotus bloom image and celebratory text when a 108-count mala is completed, triggered by a numeric prop.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala ring with 108 beads, filling beads based on count prop, with a slowly rotating ring and breathing Om symbol at the center.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBann: Displays a styled in-app notification banner with an auto-dismissing progress bar, supporting namjap, aarti, and vrat notification types with distinct colors.
Shows a brief burst animation of three Om symbols radiating outward from the center, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name to set up their profile, using a hardcoded admin token and defaulting to the 'omNamahShivaya' mantra.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders animated concentric ripple rings centered on screen when triggered, keeping up to 4 simultaneous ripples that expand and fade out over 800ms.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Sanskrit shloka with its Hindi and English meanings in a decorative card, with copy-to-clipboard and native share functionality.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A dashboard component that shows Brahma Muhurat timings, live countdowns to upcoming Ekadashi and Shivratri dates, and vrat-related daily checklists.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle switch UI component that enables or disables 'Vrat Mode', visually changing its styling between active and inactive states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: A custom hook managing AI chat state including message history (persisted to localStorage), sending messages via an AI engine, loading state, errors, and retry feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyNotifications: React hook that schedules 7 daily browser notifications (or in-app banner fallbacks) at preset hours for Nam Jap, Aarti, and Vrat reminders, with enable/disable state persisted in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Computer Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, Kathayen, community posts, Dharma quotes, Jap counters, Vrats, Bhajans, and Chalisas.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: React hook wrapping the Web Speech API to provide text-to-speech narration with Hindi/Devanagari voice selection, play/pause/stop controls, and PWA-specific workarounds for Chrome Android.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a devotional saffron/gold OKLCH color theme with light and dark mode CSS variables, Tailwind directives, custom fonts (Poppins and Tiro Devanagari Hindi), and devotional keyframe animations.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Implements an AI response engine using Pollinations.ai free APIs, with a Hindu spiritual guide persona ('Divya Guru') and multiple fallback strategies (POST, GET, and Mistral model) for generating responses.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for a Hindu astrology feature, including all 12 Rashi (zodiac) signs and templated daily prediction content for love and career aspects.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Contains static Hindi-language Katha (religious story) data including full texts of Ramayan and Mahabharat, typed to match the backend Katha schema without the 'status' field.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Implements client-side Hindu Panchang (almanac) calculations using Jean Meeus astronomical algorithms, computing sun/moon longitudes and Julian Day numbers for IST-based Hindu calendar data.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Provides static data for Hindu devotional content including Shloka and Aarti definitions, with full Hindi and English texts for Ganesh, Shiv, and Vishnu Aartis.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx: List page displaying all aartis from static data as navigable cards with emoji icons, linking to individual aarti detail routes.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single aarti supporting Hindi/English toggle, copy, share, and text-to-speech narration via useSpeechNarration hook.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabbed UI for managing kathas, vrats, user approvals, and community posts (approve/reject/delete), restricted to admin users via useIsAdmin.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: AI spiritual chat page ('दिव्य गुरु') that renders a conversation interface with suggested Hindi prompts, message history, typing indicator, and retry notifications using the useAIChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Bhajans.tsx: Bhajans page displaying a static list of Hindi devotional songs as expandable cards with per-card text-to-speech playback support.
frontend/src/pages/Chalisa.tsx: Chalisa page showing the full Hanuman Chalisa text in an expandable card with text-to-speech narration, alongside any backend-fetched chalisa entries.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community page that displays approved community posts and allows authenticated users to create new posts with optional image, video, or file attachments using a form with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Simple dashboard page that fetches and displays the authenticated user's profile with a welcome message and navigation instructions.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page displaying a hero section, daily Panchang strip, category navigation grid (jap, aarti, mantras, etc.), vrat mode banner, and a daily dharma quote with floating lotus animation.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Mantra jap (chanting) counter page featuring a mala ring UI, mantra selector, tap-to-count interaction that tracks daily/lifetime/mala counts, and triggers a lotus bloom animation at 108 counts.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail view for a single katha (religious story) that fetches from the backend with a static data fallback, and includes text-to-speech narration controls for the story content.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Kathayen listing page that merges backend and static katha data, supports search and category filtering (all/puranik/vrat), and renders results as KathaCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: A temple finder page that lets users locate nearby Hindu temples via Google Maps and features a sacred portal link with a golden ripple animation effect on click.
frontend/src/pages/Mantras.tsx: Displays a list of Hindu mantras with Sanskrit, Hindi, and English text, supporting expand/collapse and text-to-speech narration for each mantra card.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: A Hindu calendar (Panchang) page showing daily tithi, nakshatra, vara, yoga, karana, paksha, sunrise/sunset, and auspicious muhurtas with date navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page displaying lifetime and daily jap stats, mala count, vrat mode toggle, and admin badge, pulling data from backend queries and Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/VratDashboard.tsx: A vrat (fasting) dashboard showing countdown timers to upcoming Hindu festival dates, a sattvic food guide, and a daily vrat checklist.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream, warmYellow) and semantic design tokens mapped to CSS variables using oklch color space.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot for a Hindu religious app describing existing features, known issues (TTS in PWA, public visibility of kathas/community posts), and architectural notes around Internet Identity authentication and admin approval workflows.
